mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_job (stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, pause_requested, stop_requested) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{mode}, #{currentPlanIndex}, #{total}, #{status}, #{phase}, #{lastError}, #{pauseRequested}, #{stopRequested})
mapper.select: SELECT id, stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, pause_requested, stop_requested, created_at, updated_at FROM generation_job WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, pause_requested, stop_requested, created_at, updated_at FROM generation_job WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, stage_id, mode, current_plan_index, total, status, phase, last_error, pause_requested, stop_requested, created_at, updated_at FROM generation_job WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_job SET current_plan_index = #{currentPlanIndex}, phase = #{phase}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE generation_job SET pause_requested = #{pauseRequested}, stop_requested = #{stopRequested}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE generation_job SET status = #{status}, phase = #{phase}, last_error = #{lastError}, pause_requested = 0, stop_requested = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
